# Audience: external / conference-peers

For peers at a conference — state or national. Content differs by venue, but the
**structure and tone do not**: this is the same confident, credibility-forward
voice either way.

| Knob | Setting |
|---|---|
| **Tone** | Confident, generous, peer-expert. You've done the thing; share it. |
| **Reading level / jargon** | Field-appropriate jargon is fine — they're practitioners. |
| **Default theme** | Mode 1 (official), **dark** (navy). |
| **Density** | Low — stage slides, big type, demos carry the load. |
| **Formality** | Semi-formal, energetic. |
| **`data-motion`** | **`lively`** — full vocabulary, scaled up for stage presence. |
| **QR / poll / badge** | **QR and the persistent slides/resources badge welcome / on.** Polls optional. |
| **Preferred close** | A memorable sign-off plus the QR to slides and resources. |

## What to assume / emphasize
Lead with **credibility cues** — quotes, stats, real results. Assume a sharp,
skeptical room that wants proof and take-home value. Make the resources
genuinely grabbable on the way out.
